speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise; to help me determine the cause, have you noticed any specific rash, stiff neck, or sensitivity to light? Also, how many weeks pregnant are you currently?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis (Listeria monocytogenes infection).

Given your pregnancy, sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and specifically the consumption of ice cream three days prior, these findings are highly suggestive of listeriosis. I will monitor your condition closely as this infection can be serious for both you and your fetus.
